extension.summary: AB Tools - all-in-one Kodi maintenance and skin toolkit
extension.description: ABUKARIM TOOLS is an all-in-one utility for managing your Kodi setup. It bundles a Skin Installer and Skin Switcher, full backup and restore of your userdata, and quick access to the ABUKARIM Wizard and its maintenance tools (Total Clean and old thumbnail cleanup). A built-in patcher keeps popular add-ons (Seren, Prism, TinyPPI, Arctic Fuse 3, TMDbHelper, RedLight and more) working correctly on CoreELEC and Kodi, and re-applies its fixes automatically after those add-ons update. Also includes handy maintenance tools such as a speed test, a CPU benchmark and an add-on database rebuild.
extension.summary: أدوات أبوكريم - حزمة متكاملة لصيانة كودي وإدارة الواجهات
extension.description: أدوات أبوكريم هي أداة شاملة لإدارة نظام كودي لديك. تجمع بين مثبّت الواجهات ومبدّل الواجهات، والنسخ الاحتياطي الكامل لبيانات المستخدم واستعادتها، ووصولاً سريعاً إلى معالج أبوكريم وأدوات الصيانة فيه (التنظيف الشامل وحذف الصور المصغّرة القديمة). كما تتضمّن أداة ترقيع مدمجة تُبقي الإضافات الشائعة (Seren وTinyPPI وArctic Fuse 3 وTMDbHelper وRedLight وغيرها) تعمل بشكل صحيح على CoreELEC وكودي، وتعيد تطبيق إصلاحاتها تلقائياً بعد تحديث تلك الإضافات. وتشمل أيضاً أدوات صيانة مفيدة مثل اختبار السرعة واختبار أداء المعالج وإعادة بناء قاعدة بيانات الإضافات.

extension.news: v4.12.27: Search All shows each add-on as its icon (a slim one-per-line list on the left, the filter tabs, stream cards, Usenet and My folders included), lands on the best stream in All when the search ends, and shows the stream details as badges - the Fen Light, Red Light, POV and Umbrella source windows too; Arctic Fuse 3 no longer freezes from stacked widgets for skin users or after a menu rebuild. v4.12.21: Najd 2.9.7.8 never times a subtitle from another cut of the film (Director's Cut vs Theatrical), keeps the video's own subtitle timing after a slow read, and fine-tunes easynews links; a4kSubtitles no longer logs a traceback when a stream is too slow to hash. v4.12.20: Lucent Player: the button row sits a little lower and the focused button name is a little larger. v4.12.19: Lucent glass info pills work with the newer AF3 (the "i" box was white on white). v4.12.18: Arctic Fuse 3 no longer freezes when you scroll fast through stacked widgets in the hubs. v4.12.17: Najd shows its subtitle status with the skin's standard notification (smaller text in Arctic Fuse 3) instead of its own box on the video. v4.12.15: Najd 2.9.7.5 with its author's latest fixes. v4.12.14: Lucent Look player time labels work with AF3 3.5.7. v4.12.13: Boxes without a clock battery (AM9 Pro) have the right time from the first seconds, so add-ons connect at once after a boot.
